summary.verdict: PROSPECTIVE-BLIND RESULT (PASS), sequence-bridge adjudication of the pre-registered LOCKED predictions (sha dc42f715e4d88aa0... verified intact; predictions unchanged): on the genuinely novel, never-seen WHO priority pathogen C. jejuni NCTC 11168 (NEW clade: epsilon-proteobacteria), de-novo CarveMe FBA-essential genes are ENRICHED for EXPERIMENTAL essentiality (DEG DEG1049, Mandal 2017 Tn-seq, 166 essential proteins mapped by mmseqs to 166 of our genes): odds ratio 3.92 (Fisher p=0.0006524), precision 0.267, recall 0.218 (12 both / 33 FBA-only / 43 exp-only / 464 neither). This is a SECOND independent prospective-blind confirmation (n=2 with BLIND1) that the FBA-essentiality mechanism signal predicts experimental essentiality on a pre-registered, never-seen pathogen — now extended to a new phylogenetic clade. SCOPE: essentiality-enrichment only; sparse de-novo GEM; in-silico FBA vs published Tn-seq; hypotheses; not wet-lab.
